source: Cotality US Home Price Insights, Nov. 2026 (Sept. data)

headline: Illinois leads the
nation in *price gains*
slides.sub: Nationally, growth cooled to 1.7% and prices slipped month over month.
slides.fig_caption: Illinois single-family home prices, Sept. 2026 vs. a year earlier

slides.title: Top states for *price growth*
slides.note: Biggest declines: Washington -1.0%, Wyoming -0.7% and Texas -0.4%. Every Northeast and Midwest state *posted a gain*.

slides.label: national change, *Aug. to Sept.*
slides.body: The largest monthly drop since 2022. September typically brings a gain of about 0.2%. Year over year, prices are still up 1.7%.

slides.title: Where prices are *moving*
points: Many Northeast and Midwest markets are up 25% to 30% since mid-2022.
Much of the West and Texas shows little or no net growth over that stretch.
Austin fell 2.0% and Dallas 1.0% over the year.

slides.title: Local data *beats headlines*
slides.body: National prices are flattening, but tight inventory is still lifting Great Lakes markets like Illinois. Price listings off local comps, not national averages.
